regions.today: Dry with sunny spells. Becoming cloudier this afternoon with the odd spot of light rain or drizzle possible. Highest temperatures of 18 to 22 degrees with light to moderate southwest to westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Cloudy but dry for most, with limited clear spells developing and just the odd spot of drizzle and mist around, as well as some hill fog. Mild and humid with lowest temperatures of 14 to 16 degrees in mostly moderate southwest to west winds.
regions.tomorrow: Continuing cloudy but dry for most, with limited bright or sunny spells developing and just the odd spot of drizzle or mist possible. Highest temperatures of 17 to 23 degrees, warmest in the south, in moderate southwest winds.
